corrections.reason: Parallelism with ዘመኑ ... ወርኁ ... ዕለቱ ... ሰዓቱ ('its month is the month of Megabit'); the 2nd-order ካዕብ stroke on ኁ is visible on the right side of the glyph.
Classical Ge'ez 3rd person masculine plural imperfect verb ይሄልዉ (with 2nd-order ዉ, matching the quotation in Col 3 L23 and L37).
